# RETRO BOOMER v1.0.1

Release qualification: pending

This candidate retains the existing consensus rules, fees, genesis and approved
HistoryStep proof bank. The v1.0.1 proof archive reuses the eight approved v1.0.0
cryptographic files without regeneration and preserves their generation provenance.

The GUI default external media endpoint is `https://tradedata.retroboomer.org/`.
External Data remains disabled by default. The existing environment override is
preserved. Availability of the public service has not been verified for this release.

The Linux x86_64 Core archive additionally includes `retro-boomer-media`.
Other Core archives and GUI packages retain their existing binary sets.
Release products remain Core and GUI packages for Linux x86_64, Linux aarch64,
Windows x86_64, macOS x86_64 and macOS aarch64, plus the approved proof archive.

Five-platform builds, runtime checks and operator acceptance must complete before
qualification can be marked as passed. This document does not attest that the
candidate has passed those checks or that the release has been published.
Windows signing and macOS notarization must not be assumed.
